lean.statement:
theorem result
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (p : Polynomial ℝ) :
    ∃ hfeature : ∀ w : {w : E // ‖w‖ = 1},
      MemLp (fun x : E => p.eval ⟪w.1, x⟫_ℝ) 2 (ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian E),
      Continuous (fun w : {w : E // ‖w‖ = 1} =>
        (hfeature w).toLp (fun x : E => p.eval ⟪w.1, x⟫_ℝ)) ∧
      ∀ rho : Measure {w : E // ‖w‖ = 1}, IsProbabilityMeasure rho →
        (∀ x : E, Integrable (fun w : {w : E // ‖w‖ = 1} => p.eval ⟪w.1, x⟫_ℝ) rho) ∧
        Integrable (fun w : {w : E // ‖w‖ = 1} =>
          (hfeature w).toLp (fun x : E => p.eval ⟪w.1, x⟫_ℝ)) rho ∧
        ∃ hmean : MemLp (fun x : E => ∫ w : {w : E // ‖w‖ = 1},
            p.eval ⟪w.1, x⟫_ℝ ∂rho) 2 (ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian E),
          hmean.toLp (fun x : E => ∫ w : {w : E // ‖w‖ = 1}, p.eval ⟪w.1, x⟫_ℝ ∂rho) =
            ∫ w : {w : E // ‖w‖ = 1},
              (hfeature w).toLp (fun x : E => p.eval ⟪w.1, x⟫_ℝ) ∂rho
approved_definition_context: MemLp f 2 mu means that the displayed real function is almost-everywhere strongly measurable and has finite L2 seminorm under mu. Its toLp f value is the actual equivalence class of f under almost-everywhere equality, endowed with the standard L2 norm topology.

The subtype {w : E // norm w = 1} has the subspace topology and induced Borel measurable structure inherited from E. stdGaussian E is the standard centered Gaussian measure with identity covariance on the finite-dimensional real inner-product space. Polynomial is the type of finite polynomials with the displayed real coefficients.

Every displayed integral is the actual Mathlib Bochner integral in its indicated target vector space. This operator is totalized outside its integrable domain; Integrable f mu explicitly certifies almost-everywhere strong measurability and finite integral of the norm. IsProbabilityMeasure rho means rho has total mass one.
